# Pyongyang Satellite Analysis PoC

This website provides a proof-of-concept service for satellite-based analysis of North Korea.

## Main service

https://pyongyang-satellite-poc.vercel.app/

## AI-readable page

https://pyongyang-satellite-poc.vercel.app/ai-test.html

## Main features

- VIIRS nighttime light analysis
- Hansen Global Forest Change analysis
- Satellite imagery comparison
- North Korea facility information
- Evidence-based analysis with observations, interpretations, and sources
